description: Open the Ticket of the variable ticket by its address, as a shared link does, and wait until every part of its Overview has arrived, as Aura's end-to-end tests do (expectOverviewShown): its details, the CVSS assessments and the sources of its CVE, and its participants. Its waits need a Ticket with a CVE, CVSS assessments, and participants, such as SNTL-12.

steps.caption: The Ticket opens on its Overview
steps.narration: The Ticket opens on its Overview, below its status and priority: its CVE, its packages, and its details.
